Discover Premium Spray Dried Aloe Vera Powder

Tradenest Naturals proudly manufactures high-purity spray dried aloe vera powder for international markets. We use advanced spray-drying technology to lock in the natural goodness of fresh aloe vera leaves. Therefore, our dehydrated aloe vera powder retains maximum bioactive compounds, vitamins, and minerals. As an established aloe vera powder exporter, we support businesses across the food, beverage, and cosmetic sectors. We also offer reliable supply chains as a trusted bulk aloe vera powder supplier india. Our wholesale aloe vera powder is versatile and easy to reconstitute. Whether you need an aloe vera powder manufacturer or a partner for custom formulations, we deliver consistent excellence. In addition, our aloe vera freeze dried powder bulk options provide exceptional solubility and extended shelf life. We manage every step from raw material selection to final export packaging with strict quality control.

Advanced Manufacturing and Processing Excellence

We source fresh, mature aloe vera leaves from trusted agricultural networks. First, we wash and fillet the leaves to extract pure inner leaf gel. Then, we filter and pasteurize the liquid extract to ensure microbial safety. Next, our state-of-the-art spray dryers convert the liquid extract into a fine, free-flowing powder. This precise thermal control preserves delicate polysaccharides and active nutrients without harmful chemical additives. Consequently, our production method guarantees high purity and consistent batch performance.

Strict Quality Standards and Certifications

Quality remains the core of our manufacturing philosophy at Tradenest Naturals. We operate under stringent Food Safety Management Systems and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Furthermore, every batch undergoes rigorous laboratory testing for moisture, heavy metals, and microbial counts. We provide comprehensive Certificates of Analysis (CoA) with every shipment. Therefore, our global clients receive safe, compliant, and premium ingredients that meet international regulatory standards.

Versatile Industry Applications

Our spray dried aloe vera powder serves multiple industries globally. In the beverage sector, manufacturers use it to formulate functional health drinks and nutrient-rich juices. Cosmetic brands incorporate our powder into skin creams, lotions, and soothing gels because of its hydrating properties. Moreover, nutraceutical companies utilize it in dietary supplements and capsules. Food processors also blend it into functional foods to enhance nutritional value.

Packaging, Shelf Life, and Storage Conditions

We pack our powders in food-grade, moisture-resistant, and tamper-evident materials. Our standard export packaging includes 25 kg HDPE drums with inner polyethylene liners. Smaller retail packs like stand-up pouches and PET jars are also available for private label brands. When stored in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight, the product maintains its efficacy for up to 24 months.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried aloe vera powder?

Our MOQ is flexible depending on your packaging requirements and order type. However, standard bulk export orders typically start at 100 kg to ensure optimal freight efficiency.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Our manufacturing facilities follow strict GMP and food safety standards. Each batch includes a complete Certificate of Analysis (CoA) confirming purity and safety.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We offer 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg bulk packaging options. The product has a shelf life of 24 months when stored correctly.

What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)?

Our powder features an 80-100 mesh particle size, moisture content below 5%, and 100% pure aloe vera extract without fillers.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote?

Standard lead times range from 7 to 14 business days depending on order volume. You can easily request a quote or sample by contacting our sales team directly through our website.
